rule: the smoke run measures s_upd (mean wall seconds per update over updates 3..20; the run must complete all 20 updates, else FAIL), s_cal (mean wall seconds of its two calibration passes, at update 0 and 20) and the per-token inference rate as the larger of s_cal/(N_cal*128) and the rate of one S8 batch of 256 fit windows (L = 1024); projected_train(U) = U*s_upd + (U/100 + 1)*s_cal; projected_eval = 1.5 * rate * (tokens_main + tokens_timing) with tokens_main = N_test*(128+1024+576) + N_test*128 + 3*N_test*128 and tokens_timing = 7*256*sum_cond(2*L_cond + 256); with the ledger total so far (data + smoke) and margins 300 s wall / 600 s CPU (CPU projected with the smoke's cpu/wall ratio), U = 2000 if the wall and CPU sums are within 3600 s / 7200 s; otherwise U = the largest multiple of 100 that satisfies both; if U < 500 the run is INCOMPLETE_BUDGET and test is not opened. The decision is written by the smoke stage and read by the train stage; it is not changed after seeing any performance
